confirmed: Avast intercepts the provider HTTPS connection even from the Docker container. Peer issuer matches the Avast root trusted on Windows and inside the container.
That interception explains why stock gRPC roots rejected the provider certificate while installed OS trust succeeded.
Generation can also time out on REST; failures are not exclusive to gRPC.
The latest explicit-thinking request returned actual HTTP 503 with provider status UNAVAILABLE, not only an SDK-mapped status.
Historical successful REST response ended MAX_TOKENS at 1024; no complete draft yet.
The old SDK lacks thinking configuration and discards newer usage/model fields.

Whether minimal thinking or 4096 tokens would produce an accurate complete draft
Billing, quota or credential failure as the cause
